deadline_origins.cleanup: Job termination; no semantic cancel or recovery guarantee
deadline_origins.headers: final fetch start; 60s; official idle also runs before headers
deadline_origins.idle: official adapter stream start/reset on adapter activity; 60s including preheaders
deadline_origins.ready: supervisor wait after Worker launch; SDK initialize=20 within ready=30
deadline_origins.result: supervisor wait after submit send; 115s includes RPC/generation/terminal; contains 90s request plus bounded local overhead
deadline_origins.rpc: SDK RPC each=5; submit acknowledgement, not whole generation
deadline_origins.total: official adapter request and final fetch have independent 90s deadlines; earlier wins; heartbeats cannot extend total
deadline_origins.worker: supervisor start, 165s; 30+115+5+5=155 leaves 10s margin; startup/overhead may trigger earlier outer bound

body.inference: descriptive correlated development observations; no ranking, significance, equivalence or causal improvement
body.intervention: only original A checklist; B follows actual own-arm A; both options reverse; A wire equal across hidden worlds
